session.title: Kiara Stumpjumper clipless 2K loops with anaerobic microdose
session.purpose: Use green readiness and low Garmin ACWR to add bike-specific load at Kiara while keeping the new clipless pedal variable controlled and avoiding Bukit Dinding logistics.

dose.readiness_basis: 2026-06-19 morning: green readiness 70, Body Battery wake/current 88/89, HRV balanced, sleep score 84, Garmin ACWR 0.7 LOW, high-aerobic shortage.
dose.venue: Bukit Kiara / 2K access, tarmac climb, and 2K descent.
dose.warm_up: 20 min easy access and clipless confidence check; include several smooth roll-stop-unclip reps before any intensity.
dose.decision_gate: Do the anaerobic block only if clipless release feels automatic, tarmac is dry enough, legs feel normal, and the first 15-20 min are calm.

anaerobic_microdose.where: Tarmac climb or safe straight tarmac only; never on roots, corners, singletrack, wet paint, or traffic-conflict areas.
anaerobic_microdose.primary_set: 4 x 1:30 at 285-300 W with 4:00 easy recovery.
anaerobic_microdose.optional_extension: Reps 5-6 only if reps 1-4 are smooth, power is controlled, unclipping feels automatic, and recovery breathing is calm.
anaerobic_microdose.hard_cap: 6 total reps. If any rep feels forced or clipless confidence drops, stop the set at 4 or earlier.

2k_loop_work.climb_cap_after_intervals: 170-190 W average; no chasing Tuesday lap 9.
2k_loop_work.descent_rule: Cruise at 6-7/10 with quiet feet, early unclip planning, clean braking, and no speed chasing.

dose.load_cap: Target Garmin load 120-170. Hard cap 190 or 2 hours, whichever comes first.
dose.fueling: 30-60 g carbs/hour plus fluid and sodium because Kiara heat cost is real even when the ride feels controlled.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A short controlled anaerobic dose on tarmac can address Garmin's high-intensity suggestion and support MTB repeatability, while the 2K loops maintain climb-descent specificity. Keeping intensity off technical terrain protects clipless adaptation and preserves Saturday trail quality.
execution_rules: Warm up until clipless release is automatic before any power work.
Treat the Fenix 6 x 1:30 @ 300 W workout as optional inspiration, not an order.
Power reps happen only on predictable tarmac; no technical anaerobic efforts today.
After the power block, descents are skill-quality checks, not segment attempts.
If the first two reps do not feel controlled, cancel the remaining reps and convert to aerobic 2K loops.

expected_result.rpe: 5-7 if anaerobic block is completed; 3-5 if skipped
expected_result.next_day: Should still allow easy PCP or technical practice if recovery is normal, but Saturday gets downshifted if Body Battery/HRV respond poorly.

stop_rules: Stop the anaerobic block immediately if unclipping feels delayed, awkward, or mentally distracting.
Stop intensity if the tarmac is wet/slippery, traffic-conflicted, or traction is uncertain.
End the ride if braking timing, vision, or foot confidence deteriorates on descents.
No extra loops after Garmin load 170 unless the session is clearly easy and clipless remains automatic; absolute stop at load 190 or 2 hours.
Stop for crash, near-fall, sharp pain, or repeated technical mistakes.
